preservation.audit: Current implementation HEAD and remote match; no protected-path diffs; unchanged public inventory; no Folio processes, registrations or per-executable test policies. User-library preservation relies on enforced isolated profiles rather than inspecting private content.

limitations: macOS native runtime is unverified; packaging is separate evidence.
Manual Open-dialog navigation, physical printing and tool-specific native output remain outside this pass.
Forced termination may leave an unpublished temporary file or lose pending edits without a completed checkpoint.
Final flush/readback is not a universal power-loss guarantee; interrupted publication may leave an unacknowledged completed copy.
An already-open OS dialog requires user dismissal; no programmatic dialog cancellation API is assumed.
Published downloads do not contain this development feature.
